trap.label: modal
trap.why: Modais não levam to. Dedução: must be (certeza que é) × can’t be (certeza que não é).

mcq.q: She works nonstop. She **___** be exhausted.
He is on holiday. He **___** be at the office.
Qual está correta? (Strong deduction (must, can’t) · B2-L022)

fix.wrong: He mustn’t be at home; his car is gone.
fix.right: He can’t be at home; his car is gone.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “I’m sure he isn’t at home.” (can’t)
Dedução negativa: “She must be at home.” (can’t)
